_about: Public datasets the real-data differential harness can run on.
Nothing here is trusted until it is pinned. `sha256` is null for every
entry because this file was written without network access, and a
checksum nobody has computed is worse than no checksum at all: it looks
like provenance and is not. `fetch.py --pin` downloads an entry, records
the digest and the byte count it actually observed into
checksums.lock.json, and every later fetch verifies against that lock.
A run whose data was not verified against the lock is stamped
`data_pinned: false` in its result record and cannot pass verify.py.

year_prediction_msd.version: UCI ML Repository id 203, static export endpoint
year_prediction_msd.license: See the UCI page for id 203. Derived from the Million Song Dataset (Bertin-Mahieux et al., 2011).
year_prediction_msd.citation: Bertin-Mahieux, T., Ellis, D., Whitman, B., Lamere, P. The Million Song Dataset. ISMIR 2011.

split.note: The split the dataset ships with. The last 51630 rows are held out so that no song by an artist in the test set appears in training.

year_prediction_msd.notes: Dense float features, no missing values, target is a release year. The regression scenario's real-data option.

bank_marketing.version: UCI ML Repository id 222, static export endpoint
bank_marketing.license: See the UCI page for id 222.
bank_marketing.citation: Moro, S., Rita, P., Cortez, P. Bank Marketing. UCI Machine Learning Repository, 2014.
bank_marketing.notes: Roughly one positive in nine, ten categorical columns. The imbalanced-binary scenario's real-data option; also exercises categorical handling, which is why the categorical scenario uses a different dataset.

covertype.version: UCI ML Repository id 31, static export endpoint
covertype.license: See the UCI page for id 31. Copyright Jock A. Blackard and Colorado State University.
covertype.citation: Blackard, J. Covertype. UCI Machine Learning Repository, 1998.
covertype.notes: Seven forest cover classes, badly unbalanced across them, 54 columns of which 44 are binary indicators. A hash split rather than the documented 11340-row training prefix, because the prefix trains on two percent of the data and this harness is also measuring training time on a real matrix. The split rule is in the record.

adult.version: UCI ML Repository id 2, static export endpoint
adult.license: See the UCI page for id 2. Extracted from the 1994 US Census bureau database.
adult.citation: Becker, B., Kohavi, R. Adult. UCI Machine Learning Repository, 1996.

split.note: The split the dataset ships with, 32561 train and 16281 test. The first line of adult.test is a comment and its labels carry a trailing period.

adult.notes: Real categorical columns and real missing values, marked with '?'. The categorical-and-missing scenario's real-data option, and the reason that scenario does not need a synthetic hole pattern to be interesting.

rcv1_train_binary.version: LIBSVM dataset page, binary section, rcv1_train.binary
rcv1_train_binary.license: Derived from Reuters Corpus Volume 1. See the LIBSVM dataset page and the RCV1 terms.
rcv1_train_binary.citation: Lewis, D., Yang, Y., Rose, T., Li, F. RCV1: A New Benchmark Collection for Text Categorization Research. JMLR 5, 2004.
rcv1_train_binary.notes: The high-dimensional sparse scenario's real-data option. Around 0.16 percent of entries are stored, so it only fits comfortably as CSC. LIBSVM's train and test halves are swapped relative to the usual convention: the small file is the one named train.

mslr_web10k.license: Microsoft Research licence, accepted on the download page.
mslr_web10k.citation: Qin, T., Liu, T.-Y. Introducing LETOR 4.0 Datasets / MSLR-WEB10K. Microsoft Research.

split.note: Queries are whole on one side of the split by construction, since the fold files are split by query.

mslr_web10k.notes: Acquisition is manual on purpose. The download is behind a redirecting link that changes, so pinning a URL would be pinning a lie. Point MOJOBOOST_BENCH_DATA at a directory holding Fold1 and fetch.py --pin will checksum the two files it reads. Until then the ranking scenario runs on its generator.

higgs.version: UCI ML Repository id 280, static export endpoint
higgs.license: See the UCI page for id 280.
higgs.citation: Baldi, P., Sadowski, P., Whiteson, D. Searching for exotic particles in high-energy physics with deep learning. Nature Communications 5, 2014.

split.note: The last 500000 rows are the documented test set.

higgs.notes: Eleven million rows, a few gigabytes decompressed. Large tier, never in the default suite, and the only entry that justifies a scaling claim on real data.

news20_binary.version: LIBSVM dataset page, binary section, news20.binary
news20_binary.citation: Keerthi, S., DeCoste, D. A Modified Finite Newton Method for Fast Solution of Large Scale Linear SVMs. JMLR 6, 2005.
news20_binary.notes: 1.36 million features. Large tier because the feature count, not the row count, is what hurts: a per-feature histogram pass over that many columns is the interesting case.
